title: Counting the Visits in an Authorization Extension Request — Insured Plan of Care
content:
**Central Authorization Unit — Insured Plan of Care, extension visit count.**

**Clause.** The period runs from today for as many days as the current authorization covers, its days counted from the first through the last, both included. The visits the extension asks for are the payer program's weekly visit maximum times the days of the period, divided by seven and rounded up to a whole visit.

**The current authorization.** It is the authorization whose number and end date the plan record shows as current; the days it covers run from the first date of service of its approval through its end date, both included.

## Worked counts (hypothetical)

| Current authorization covers | Days it covers | Weekly visit maximum | Weekly maximum times days, divided by 7 | Visits asked for |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 2026-04-01 to 2026-05-12 | 42 | 3 | 18 | 18 |
| 2026-04-01 to 2026-05-12 | 42 | 2 | 12 | 12 |
| 2026-04-01 to 2026-04-30 | 30 | 3 | 12.8571 | 13 |

With today 2026-05-05 and a current authorization of 42 days, the period runs from 2026-05-05 through 2026-06-15.
